title: NCAIR physical address
text: Physical Address: Plot 790, Alimoh-Abu Street, Behind VIO Yard, Wuye District, Abuja, Nigeria.

title: New intern physical onboarding location
text: Physical registration happens strictly at the 50-Seater Hall, e-Government Building (PSIN) right after orientation for new interns.

title: Physical registration support channels
text: There is no external registration support link or phone line because onboarding is done physically on-site with facilitators in the PSIN hall.

title: Official course curriculum and progression
text: The official courses offered across cohorts follow this strict order: 1. Python Beginners 2. Python Advanced 3. Data Science Beginners 4. Data Science Advanced 5. Product Design Beginners 6. Product Design Advanced 7. Product Development 8. Embedded Systems.

title: SIWES intern first cohort courses
text: SIWES Intern First Cohort: Must register for and complete Python Beginners AND Product Design (UI/UX) Beginners simultaneously.

title: NYSC CDS day and class excuse
text: NYSC Interns: Select their courses and pick their specific CDS Day on the registration form. Selecting a CDS day automatically grants an official excuse from classes on that day.

title: SIWES logbook signing frequency
text: SIWES Logbook Signing: SIWES interns must physically present and sign their logbooks at NCAIR Headquarters every two (2) weeks.

title: Class schedule and session duration
text: Class Schedule: Classes run three (3) times a week, lasting approximately 2 to 3 hours per session depending on the cohort.

title: Attendance threshold and automatic retake rule
text: Attendance Threshold: A minimum of 75% attendance is strictly required to pass any cohort. Retake Rule for Low Attendance: Even if an intern passes all tests, assessments, and final project presentations with distinction, failing to meet the 75% attendance threshold results in an automatic retake of that cohort.

title: Course completion and next course
text: Course Completion: Passing both attendance and assessments unlocks the next course in the sequence under "My Learning -> Courses".

title: Registration closing time and locked buttons
text: Registration Window: Registration is opened physically on the day and closes strictly at 5:00 PM (buttons show "Locked" outside this window).

title: Missing invitation email troubleshooting
text: Missing Invitation Email: Check Spam, Junk, or Trash folders in Gmail. Move the email to the Inbox first before tapping "Complete Registration".

title: LMS password requirements
text: Password Requirements: Must be at least 8 characters long, containing at least one number and one letter.

title: Document upload formats and file-size limit
text: Document Upload Limits: All uploaded ID documents or letters must be in PDF or PNG format and under 2MB in file size.

title: Returning intern account and sign-in credentials
text: Returning interns do NOT need to onboard again. Go directly to https://lms.ncair.nitda.gov.ng/intern/signin using their existing email and password.

title: Returning intern failed-course retake
text: Failed Courses: View the failed course under "Courses" and tap "Re-register" to retake it.
